name: CreateTask
description: Creates one task in CollectionQueue for a customer, with the customer name and owning bookkeeper taken from the data (CustomerOwners first, else Customers.assignedBookkeeperName), never from the caller. Every task gets taskKey manual:<taskType>:<relatedId, else customerCode>, so it appears in the keyed tasks list and the daily scan never touches it; skips a duplicate (an open task with the same key, or the same customer, taskType and relatedId). Sets every task column (title, severity, severityScore, source, openedAt, lastCheckedAt). Test customers (TEST-) produce rows marked isTestFixture. Receipt first (r3): the unknown-payer type is written as 'לא זוהה' (input 'לא מזוהה' is accepted and stored as 'לא זוהה'); needsManagerApproval (default false) is always written.

reasons.description: Why, in Hebrew, from the data

dueAt.description: When it should be handled. Default next business day 09:00 Israel

dryRun.description: When true, only report what would be written; nothing changes

needsManagerApproval.description: True when the task must be approved by a manager. Default false
